note: Framed high-efficiency 25 mm coin exciter. Coil mass is the sheet's Mms. Suspension stiffness is derived as Mms*(2π·Fs)² = 3189 N/m (sheet Cms 0.0003 matches that as m/N; the sheet's mm/N label is treated as a unit typo). Magnet mass is the published product weight 110.9 g minus Mms (frame mass is not broken out). Qms and Xmax are not published; suspension loss is left at zero and travel is unlimited in the model with a label. Read 2026-11-25.
